description:
Add an entry to the journal of an adapter. The entry is stored as given. This is the same as add_object() with object type _AdaptiveJournalEntry_, but returns the new entry's cursor.

Include something like an eventType property in entries you write, so a peer's consumeFilter can tell them apart from each other and from the entries an adapter writes for its object changes.

parameters.description: Id of the adapter whose journal gets the entry.
parameters.name: adapterId
